segments.title: Polar bears have black skin!
segments.say: Hi! I'm Maya from Canada. Did you know polar bears have black skin?

segments.title: White fur, black skin!
segments.say: Under all that white fur, its skin is black!

segments.title: Babies start pink
segments.say: Cubs are born pink, and turn black at about three months.

segments.title: Why black skin?
segments.say: Why black? To hide, soak up sun, or look cool? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Soak up the sun!
segments.say: Soak up the sun! Dark skin catches the sun's warmth.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.tiny: A new kid, a new animal
